Physics graphs follows the same guidelines as math with a few exceptions-
In physics graphs do not mention x axis, y axis labels or X, X′ on the graph axis.
Do not mention the ‘O’; origin point in the graph.
If there is explicit mention to add graph axis labels then also add origin ‘O’ in the graph.
In physics we have mainly  three types of vectors and for consistency we have assigned colors for these.
Position vectors- Please mark position vectors like r, r_1, r_2, r_21 with the Primary colour.
Vectors like forces- Other vectors like forces F_21, F_12, with secondary colour.
Resultant vector- Resultant vector like F_net ,  →F in tertiary color.
Please note that we use 5px point size in vectors.
Free body diagrams (FBD)  - Use specs of  primary vector (color- ec008c , stroke 3px , arrow scale -50%) when drawing arrows in free-body diagrams.
